name: Gateway close handling cleanup
objective: Stop normal Discord gateway reconnect control paths from being recorded as noisy 4000 socket close loops, and make resume invalidation explicit.
root_cause: The gateway worker used socket.close(4000, ...) for internal control flow when Discord sent OP 7 RECONNECT or OP 9 INVALID_SESSION.
Those worker-requested closes appeared in logs as repeated socket closed 4000, making normal reconnect behavior look like Discord-side errors.
Non-resumable invalid sessions were not represented clearly in close metadata.
implemented: Added requestedCloseResult so worker-requested reconnects use socket.close(1000, ...) while preserving shouldReconnect and canResume semantics.
Changed OP 7 RECONNECT handling to close with code 1000 and reason discord-reconnect-requested, then reconnect with resume when possible.
Changed OP 9 INVALID_SESSION handling to close with code 1000 and reason invalid-session-resumable or invalid-session-identify-required.
Added closeInvalidatesSession so fatal and non-resumable close paths invalidate stored sessions instead of preserving bad resume state.
Gateway close events now record requested_by_worker, should_reconnect, and can_resume metadata.
Heartbeat metadata now distinguishes worker-requested closes from real socket failures.
